summary.one_liner: BondAI is a Python framework for building single and multi-agent AI systems, with a CLI, Docker image, and code API.
summary.what_it_does: BondAI lets you build single-agent and multi-agent AI systems in Python. It can be used three ways: a pip-installed command line interface (`bondai`) with a preset set of tools, a Docker container, or an API imported into your own code. Agents are given tools such as DuckDuckGo or Google search, website querying, and file writing, and are run against a natural-language task. The README's example has an agent research a topic, summarize findings into a markdown file, and cite sources. Listed integrations include OpenAI and Azure OpenAI models, Google Search, DuckDuckGo, Alpaca Markets (stock and crypto trading), PostgreSQL natural-language queries, Bland AI phone calls, and Gmail search. The README also mentions PythonREPLTool and ShellTool, which run code or access the shell.
use_cases: autonomous research and summarization with citations
writing files from an AI agent via command line
natural language queries against a PostgreSQL database
AI-driven stock or crypto trading via Alpaca
making phone calls with an AI agent through Bland AI
searching and reading Gmail with an agent
notable: Three usage modes: pip CLI, Docker image, and Python API
Built-in tools for web search, website querying, and file writing
Supports OpenAI and Azure OpenAI models
Can extract a PostgreSQL schema and answer natural-language queries
Recommends Docker when using code-running or shell tools
caveats: Requires an OpenAI API key (or Azure OpenAI) to run
Code-execution and shell tools can damage the host machine, so Docker is recommended
Some integrations need separate accounts or API keys (Google Search, Alpaca, Bland AI)
